input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is very slow, and I really need excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me get this fixed?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.
Yes, please go ahead and check my phone’s network status and speed. And yes, I am using the number 555-123-2002 for my mobile data. Let me know what you find!

I don’t have any special diagnostic tools or apps on my phone. I’d appreciate it if you could guide me step-by-step through any actions you need me to take to check my network status and speed. Just let me know what to do next!

I checked my status bar, and here’s what I see at the top of my screen: Airplane Mode is on, VPN is connected, and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see any cellular signal or data icons. What should I do next?
I’ve turned Airplane Mode off. Now, I see a poor signal with 2G, data is disabled, VPN is still connected, and my battery is at 80%. What should I do next?
I’ve turned mobile data on. Now, I see a poor signal with 2G, data is enabled, VPN is still connected, and my battery is at 80%. The internet still seems very slow. What should I do next?
Yes, please go ahead and check my phone’s network status and speed. And yes, I am using the number 555-123-2002 for my mobile data. Let me know what you find!

I don’t have any special diagnostic tools or apps on my phone. I’d appreciate it if you could guide me step-by-step through any actions you need me to take to check my network status and speed. Just let me know what to do next!
I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said "No Connection." My mobile data is on, but I’m still not getting any usable internet. What should I try next?

Here’s what I see on my status bar right now:
- Airplane Mode is OFF.
- I have a poor signal and it shows 2G as the network type.
- VPN is connected.

Let me know what you’d like me to do next.
I’ve disconnected the VPN and changed the network mode to "4G/5G preferred." Now, my status bar shows an excellent signal with 5G and data enabled. What should I do next?
I tried running the speed test again, but it still failed and says "No Connection," even though I have an excellent 5G signal and data is enabled. What should I try next?
I checked my SIM card status, and it shows that the SIM card is active and working. What should I do next?
I checked, and Data Saver mode is OFF. There don’t appear to be any data restrictions active. What should I try next?

I checked my APN settings, and the current APN name is set to "internet." The MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." There’s no indication that anything is missing or incorrect. What should I do next?
I’ve reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my device. My status bar still shows an excellent 5G signal with data enabled. What should I do next?

I ran the speed test again after resetting the APN settings and rebooting, but it still failed and says "No Connection." This is getting a bit frustrating—what else can we try to get my mobile data working with excellent speed?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my phone. What should I try next to get my mobile data working?
I checked the permissions for my messaging app, and it has permissions for SMS, storage, and phone. What should I do next?
Yes, please enable roaming on my line. I’m currently abroad in France, so that might be the issue. Go ahead and turn on roaming so I can use my mobile data. Let me know once it’s done!
I tried using my mobile data again and ran the speed test, but it still failed and says "No Connection." I’m still not able to get any internet, even with roaming enabled. What else can we try?
###TRANSFER###

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.
